messages:
Ellie R: quick dump from NovaGrid onboarding call (09:30 PT). Pasting raw asks so CS->Product can triage; please flag anything renewal-impacting.

Sam G: go ahead. any urgent language?

Ellie R: four items: 
- Index visibility: after a 25k doc push they saw "indexed" status but new docs weren't returned for ~5 hours. Quote: "We walked through the demo and none of our updates were searchable."
- Embedding cost spike: large embed ops spiked token/price unexpectedly; they asked for per-team caps + alerting.
- Onboarding UI: document-mapper step is unclear; non-technical users skip mapping and pipelines fail.
- Bulk import errors: during parallel import they observed intermittent 500s and ~1% of docs reported success but never surfaced.

Priya: Routing suggestion: visibility + 500s -> infra/serving; embedding caps -> pricing & product; UI -> product-ux. Mark visibility as high priority for this account.

Jules: Can we get repro artifacts? upload timestamp, sample queries that failed, request ids, and the CSV.

Ellie R: Customer timings: upload_start=2026-11-03T16:12:05Z ingest_done=2026-11-03T16:12:22Z first_search_hit=2026-11-03T21:30:10Z. Customer quote to include: "If this keeps happening we can't roll past internal pilot."

ops-bot: Created CS-6123: NovaGrid index visibility delay (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-6123)
ops-bot: Created CS-6124: NovaGrid billing caps request (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-6124)

Ravi: I'll collect logs and attach a curl repro + the CSV to CS-6123 by EOD. Also will ask infra for ingest traces and KV-cache invalidate events.

Priya: Suggested triage weights for product sync: renewal_risk=3, demo_impact=2, eng_effort_est=2. We'll surface CS-6123/CS-6124.

Ellie R: Action items: Ravi -> logs+repro (EOD); Jules -> loop infra on traces (tomorrow AM); Priya -> prioritization on Friday sync; Ellie -> ack customer with tickets and ETA.

Sam G: Thanks team. I'll watch the ticket queue and ping if we need an exec note. :thumbsup:
